Select distinct molecule ChEMBL identifier, compound name, and canonical SMILES for all molecules mentioned in the specified document. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id filtering by document ChEMBL ID. Join compound_structures on molregno to enforce availability of canonical SMILES. Return chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles. Sort rows by chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles.
